population: Two predeclared synthetic painting cases, each tried once per condition. Human preference remains unmeasured.
method: Gemini selects and scores evidence-limited template choices. Direct uses one writing call; the tree first prunes proposed angles. Both receive the same candidate pool, evidence, model, URL, and final checks. Order alternates by case.

tree.subject: Linen Leaf Painting — a project-planner idea
tree.body:
Hi Linen Leaf Painting team,

I took a look at the Linen Leaf Painting website. The contact or estimate link returned a missing-page response both times I checked it. I built a concept where visitors can try a short painting-project planner.

Here’s the independent design preview: https://preview.example/broken-estimate

If you like this direction, would you like me to set it up for you?

Abraham

direct.subject: Linen Leaf Painting — a website idea for your painting services
direct.body:
Hi Linen Leaf Painting team,

I tried the contact link on the Linen Leaf Painting website. The contact or estimate link returned a missing-page response both times I checked it. I sketched a website concept that gives exterior painting a visible place and lets visitors plan a project.

Here’s the independent design preview: https://preview.example/broken-estimate

Would you like me to walk you through the design and what setting it up would involve?

Abraham

interpretation: Initial end-to-end pilot. Writing was conditional on a qualified FTS/model verdict, leaving one paired draft. code_review_passed records the whole production decision, including an unavailable independent model-review check. Subsequent writing-only results use both predeclared fixture cases with fixed qualified inputs. This exploratory run is retained separately.
